claims.claim: The New York Times reported Abrego Garcia was wrongfully deported last year, left for Spain, and faced the prospect of deportation to Liberia, ending a 20-month legal fight.
claims.episode_span: The Times reported that he was wrongfully deported last year.
claims.source_title: Abrego Garcia Voluntarily Leaves U.S., Ending 20-Month Legal Fight
claims.supporting_quote: Kilmar Armando Abrego Garcia, who was wrongfully deported last year, has left for Spain. He faced the prospect that the Trump administration might deport him to Liberia.

claims.claim: The Pentagon is threatening further unspecified measures against Canada unless Ottawa prioritizes continental defence, and a senior U.S. official accused Canada of NATO's widest gap between rhetoric and reality, while Defence Minister David McGuinty pushed back.
claims.episode_span: The Pentagon is threatening further, unspecified measures against Canada
claims.source_title: Pentagon prepared to 'up the ante' in defence dispute with Canada
claims.supporting_quote: The Pentagon is threatening further, unspecified measures against Canada unless Ottawa prioritizes continental defence in its military buildup. A senior U.S. official accused Canada of having NATO's widest gap between rhetoric and reality. Defence Minister David McGuinty pushed back, while experts suggested the dispute extends well beyond military spending commitments.
